name: @agent-dev/core
description: Core runtime for Agent Dev bundler plugins.

scripts.build: tsup src/index.ts --format esm,cjs --dts --sourcemap --clean --shims && cp -R src/client dist/client
scripts.dev: tsup src/index.ts --format esm,cjs --dts --sourcemap --shims --watch --onSuccess "rm -rf dist/client && cp -R src/client dist/client"
